title: Breath of the hollow
briefing: Dense fungal forest encircles the landing site. In the hollow to the east, the spores hang like fog over the ground. We need to know whether the air can be filtered before anyone has to breathe here.
goal: Take a tissue sample at the fungal rim and place a relay on the high ridge.

main_sample.label: The Fungal Rim
main_sample.text: The sample is alive. The spores bind to moisture, not metal — a fine-mesh filter keeps them out. Clean water runs close to the clearing.

risk_sample.label: The Spore Capsule
risk_sample.text: The capsule cracks open in the glove. The air here is saturated, but the meter shows enough oxygen. Almost breathable. Almost.

routes.label: Along the forest edge
routes.description: Longer, but above spore level. The suit copes fine.

routes.label: Through the hollow
routes.description: Half the distance. The spores are hard on the suit's filters.

evacuation: The suit's filters are clogged, and energy is falling. ARK: “Turn back now, Captain. Follow the lander's beacon home. Your samples are safe.”

findings.main: Viridia: The spores can be filtered. Greenhouses must stand apart from the housing.
findings.risk: Viridia: The air is almost breathable. The spores aren't toxic — there are just far too many of them.
findings.relay: Viridia: The relay on the high ridge covers the whole clearing.
